claim_one_line: R48 PHASE 2: A REQUIREMENTS LEDGER STILL RECORDS AS MISSING A THING THE SAME WINDOW SUPPLIED. Cold review, window frozen at 07e46c7f. AND IT IS A REPEAT OFFENDER: the B976-era sweep already found five of its rows reading 'absent' against banked arcs (B867, B865, B867+B881, B884+B895, B853) -- same document, same failure mode, second occurrence.
